author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Listening preview fixture (Story 3.3), the carrier rule review condition 2 (review-carrier-rule-coupled-gamma-2026-11-16.md). Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at 6 Hz, 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 60 Hz, its AM depth swelling to 100 percent at the 0 degree coupling phase (smooth swell). No binaural layer. 180 s, no loop, no ramps or fades (Epic 4). Not a starter recipe.
